mechanism_narrative: A higher level of total nonfarm employment (PAYEMS) indicates stronger labor market conditions, which supports consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive when PAYEMS is above the 50th percentile of its historical distribution (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When monthly housing starts (HOUST) exceed 500 thousand units, it signals robust residential construction activity and consumer confidence, which typically precedes stronger corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive in periods when HOUST > 500 (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and elevated inflation (CPIAUCSL > 215) signals a monetary tightening cycle amid high inflation, which typically leads to reduced equity valuations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when FEDFUNDS > 0.1 and CPIAUCSL > 215 (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: During a late-cycle expansion regime (where the economy is strong but nearing peak growth), a high level of industrial production (INDPRO > 100) indicates sustained economic momentum and positive corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive in late-cycle expansion periods when INDPRO > 100 (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeds 5.0 percent, it signals a weakening labor market and reduced consumer spending, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative when UNRATE > 5.0 (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in retail sales (RSAFS) and nonfarm employment (PAYEMS) signals robust consumer demand and a healthy labor market, which typically drives positive corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive when RSAFS > 350000 and PAYEMS > 130000 (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of industrial production (INDPRO) indicates stronger manufacturing activity and economic output, which typically supports corporate earnings growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive when INDPRO is above the 50th percentile of its historical distribution (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 215, it signals persistent inflation that may prompt monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative when CPIAUCSL > 215 (t-test p > 0.05).
